title: Crafting QOL packs
description: Set of Datapacks that users can choose to use to improve their game. This datapack is also what the project "Death Follows" uses in its server. READ DESCRIPTION
body:
**DEPRECIATED AS OF 5/21/2024**
**IF YOU WANT CURRENT VERSIONS OF THE DATAPACKS PLEASE JOIN [THE DISCORD SERVER!](https://discord.gg/kH46SaV2Ub)**

Quality of life datapack mainly focused on pairing with another project of mine "Death Follows" for making advancing in-game a little faster to compensate for how quickly the difficulty ramps up. Users who want more of a challenge should NOT use this, however for more casual users, this is perfect for you!
(Other users just looking for some other things can of course pick and choose the datapack thats right for them, disregarding the rest as they see fit for their case)

Crafting changes made here make the following changes (JEI or similar mod is reccomended to show the crafting recipes)
- Gunpowder is craftable from gravel, charcoal and netherrack
- Bundles are craftable
- Guntech Metal is now craftable from smelting iron ingots in a blast furnace (relevant to users of the Death Follows Modpack)
-Iron can be aquired through smoking gravel
- Netherite barrel is now created through 3 gold barrrels and 1 netherite ingot (relevant to users of Death Follows Modpack)
